shafi.description: Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali and Ja'fari: Asr begins when an object's shadow equals its own length plus the shadow length at noon.

hanafi.description: Hanafi: Asr begins when an object's shadow is twice its own length plus the shadow length at noon.

runtime.note: Fields listed in notApplied are published for information only: the current runtime does not implement them, so its output can differ from the authority by a few minutes.

muslim_world_league.name: Muslim World League
muslim_world_league.notes: The most widely used international default.

north_america.name: Islamic Society of North America (ISNA)
north_america.notes: Also common at high latitudes, where an 18° Fajr is not reachable in summer.

umm_al_qura.name: Umm al-Qura University, Makkah
umm_al_qura.notes: Isha is 90 minutes after Maghrib, and 120 minutes during Ramadan (the runtime switches automatically).

gulf_region.name: Gulf Region
gulf_region.authority: Gulf Region convention (AlAdhan reference location in the United Arab Emirates)
gulf_region.notes: AlAdhan documents this method as the closest match to UAE Awqaf/IACAD tables.

kuwait.name: Kuwait
kuwait.authority: Kuwait (Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs)

qatar.name: Qatar
qatar.authority: Qatar (Qatar Calendar House / Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs)
qatar.notes: Isha is 90 minutes after Maghrib; the Ramadan interval is not changed.

singapore.name: Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura (MUIS)
singapore.notes: adhan-js rounds MUIS times up to the next minute; the runtime rounds to the nearest.

france.name: Union des Organisations Islamiques de France (UOIF)
france.authority: Union des Organisations Islamiques de France (UOIF)
france.notes: A low angle chosen for high latitudes; suitable for France and neighbouring regions.

turkey.name: Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı (Turkey)
turkey.authority: Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı (Presidency of Religious Affairs, Turkey)
turkey.notes: Diyanet publishes additional minute tunings that the runtime does not apply.

russia.name: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia
russia.authority: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia

moonsighting_committee.name: Moonsighting Committee Worldwide (Moonsighting.com)
moonsighting_committee.notes: The full Moonsighting.com method (shafaq-based Isha and its own high-latitude rules) is approximated by 18°/18°; adhan-js additionally applies dhuhr +5 and maghrib +3.

dubai.name: Dubai (IACAD)
dubai.authority: Dubai Islamic Affairs and Charitable Activities Department (IACAD)
dubai.notes: IACAD publishes additional minute tunings that the runtime does not apply.

algeria.name: Algeria
algeria.authority: Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs and Wakfs

indonesia.name: Kementerian Agama Republik Indonesia (KEMENAG)
indonesia.notes: KEMENAG adds an ihtiyati safety margin of 2 minutes; not applied by the runtime.

morocco.name: Morocco
morocco.authority: Moroccan Ministry of Habous and Islamic Affairs

tehran.name: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran
tehran.authority: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran (Iran)
tehran.reason: Requires Maghrib computed from an angle (4.5°). The runtime always derives Maghrib from sunset, so this method cannot be reproduced yet.

jafari.name: Shia Ithna-Ashari, Leva Institute, Qum
jafari.nameAr: الشيعة الإثنا عشرية، معهد ليفا، قم
jafari.reason: Requires Maghrib computed from an angle (4°).

portugal.name: Comunidade Islamica de Lisboa
portugal.reason: Uses a fixed Maghrib offset (sunset + 3 min), which the runtime does not support.

jordan.name: Ministry of Awqaf, Islamic Affairs and Holy Places (Jordan)
jordan.authority: Jordanian Ministry of Awqaf, Islamic Affairs and Holy Places
jordan.reason: Uses a fixed Maghrib offset (sunset + 5 min), which the runtime does not support.
